title: A magyar nyelv diadala és nemzeti jelképei (Language, Culture & National Feeling)
grammar: Evidential & Modal Particles in Reformist Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how Hungarian became the official language in 1844.
I can use küszöbén áll and hatására to describe the eve of a change.
I can name Kölcsey's Himnusz, Vörösmarty's Szózat and the first permanent Hungarian theatre.
I can use eight new words about language and national symbols.
